name: GTB-22 Faze
description: The GTB-22 "Faze" is designed as a light skirmisher meant for supporting a task force ahead of an offensive by pushing a hostile force's flanks from normally uncoventional angles. It accomplishes this through its core jump jet system, which allows it to leap considerable distances up towards pieces of terrain normally inaccessible to most mobile suits. The Faze's powerful legs allows for it to jump up to a respectable height, before its jump jets fire off to grant it additional altitude. The Faze is also one of a few mobile weapons that can turn its body almost completely independent of the orientation of its legs, allowing for it to retain a wide field of fire while moving.

traits.name: Integrated Jump Jets
traits.description: When Moving or Boosting, may treat any movement as Flying as long as movement is ended on solid ground, or else begin falling.

traits.name: Agile
traits.description: The Faze receives +1 Accuracy on AGILITY checks and saves.

core_system.name: "Kangaroo" Rapid Multi-Jump Jet System
core_system.active_effect: Until the end of the scene, 1/round the Faze may boost as a free action. Any movement made when this core power is active can also choose to give the Faze 1 additional space of elevation along with standard movement.
core_system.description: The GTB-22 Faze possesses a series of thrusters designed to aid it in leaping long distances, firing off in the middle of a jump in order to grant it additional airtime and horizontal reach in its jump. The main jump thrusters can then be reversed to accelerate the Faze towards the ground, allowing for it to land on solid ground quickly. This system can also be used as a powerful–albeit risky–attack against enemy machines.
core_system.passive_effect: May use the Ground Pound free action.

passive_actions.name: Ground Pound
passive_actions.detail: 1/round, if the Faze is in midair, may immediately force the Faze to hit the ground as a free action. The Faze's resilient servoes built for hard impacts allows for it to take 1 AP Kinetic per 5 spaces fallen instead of the standard rules for falling. If it instead lands next to an enemy of Size 1 or larger, the enemy must roll an Agility Save. On a fail, they take 1d3 Kinetic damage for every three spaces the Faze has fallen and the Faze gains Resistance to the falling damage inflicted normally. On a pass, the Faze falls and lands as normal.

name: PTX-140 Hardballer
description:
One of the first machines designed by NEVEC from the ground up for combating Mobile Suits, the PTX-140 Hardballer is an agile machine built for aggressive hit-and-run tactics. It accomplishes this through its integrated flight backpack that allows it to either leap and hover for respectable distances or skate across the ground at high speeds. Along with being able to mount a versatile array of weapons, the Hardballer also includes a close combat weapon specifically designed for it that is commonly described as an oversized chainsaw.
Being smaller than most Mobile Suits yet larger than a majority of Junior Mobile Suits, NEVEC has coined the term 'Vital Suit' to describe this new size class of mobile weapon.

traits.name: Thruster Skating
traits.description: 1/round, after you Boost, the Hardballer may move additional hexes up to the pilot's Grit that ignores engagement. The boost also forces enemy reactions against it to take +1 Difficulty.

traits.name: Integrated Flight Systems
traits.description: When Boosting, the Hardballer may opt to Fly in exchange for taking 2 Heat.

core_system.name: Integrated Motorized Close Combat Weaponry
core_system.active_effect: The VS Saw immediately deploys and revs up. Gain 5 Charges. Until the end of the scene or until all charges are expended, a charge may be expended as a free action to use the VS Saw.
core_system.description: Mounted in a wrist module on one of its arms, the Hardballer possesses a close combat weapon in the form of a motorized chain blade. This weapon, once extended and revved up, can tear apart armor and internal components of other mobile suits.
